explicit_non_goals: Do not promote product candidates to Human Accepted or Served.
Do not create heartbeat bureaucracy or global distributed locks by default.
Do not require the human to manually track workers, Returns, heads, epochs or convergence.
Do not put private Capture/Patent/transcript content in public network artifacts.
Do not force every worker to read full NETWORK on every turn.
Do not replace the frozen map with another large plan.
Do not claim already-open unaware chats were bootstrapped remotely.
automatable_done_when: Runtime v3 public entry and manifest exist and route correctly.
A short public one-line bootstrap URL exists.
Tiny semantic EPOCH fast path exists.
Derived NETWORK and CONVERGENCE views exist.
Workers write independent status objects instead of one shared mutable status file.
Workstreams can be discovered/scaffolded without manual central-list ceremony.
Compiled packets include only relevant unseen deltas/dependency/convergence information.
Stale or missing RETURN recovers from small Git delta.
Parallel disjoint workers proceed while real write collisions/dependency changes are surfaced only to affected workers.
Privacy and authority boundaries are preserved.
Publication writes only derived coordination artifacts and does not mutate product HTML.
Falsifying scenarios in EXECUTION_FREEZE section 19 pass or produce an explicit remaining blocker.
true_human_boundary: Already-open chats that never learned the private Prometeo command still require one one-line bootstrap message from the human. Their own valid violet seal is the evidence that a particular chat actually loaded the runtime; infrastructure cannot fabricate this remotely.
